program.name: Athlete Shuffle
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Athletic training that never repeats: speed work with a lift after, or strength with a burst after.
program.about: Athletic training, never the same day twice, and every session trains both sides of it. Speed days deal running drills, court moves, jumps, upper-body power, sprints, skips or footwork, then a short lift; strength days deal legs, glutes, calves, single-leg work, pulls, pushes or the back of the body, then a short Tabata. Each comes in a different format every time. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Every day different · speed or strength, then the other
